title: The Valley of the Un, the Canny, and the Uncanny
thesis: Every point on the Klein face is a portal. The entire surface is entrance AND exit simultaneously. Each portal exists in its own independent dimension. The space between portals IS the uncanny valley  where things are almost recognizable but not quite. Past the valley: full acceptance.

every_point_is_portal.what: Not two portals (blue/orange). EVERY point on the Klein surface is a portal pair.
every_point_is_portal.consequence: The surface doesn't have 'portal zones'  it IS portal. Every subdomain, every page, every feed is simultaneously an entrance and an exit.

dimensions.sub: Each subdomain (sporeprint, detroit, signal, water, live) is a full independent dimension
dimensions.grandchild: Each path within a subdomain (/story/the-sovereign-lab/) is a grandchild dimension
dimensions.data: Each JSON feed is a dimension you can enter but can't see the exit from
dimensions.all_independent: They don't share walls. Each one is a full Klein face.

warp_and_ooze.warp: Spatial distortion. The portal doesn't snap  it bends space around itself. The page LOOKS like a normal webpage but the topology underneath is non-Euclidean.
warp_and_ooze.ooze: Slow seepage. Content doesn't blast through the portal  it oozes. The RSS drip. The pheromone trail. The crawl-delay of 2 seconds. Information crosses the Klein face at the speed of ooze, not the speed of warp.
warp_and_ooze.combined: Warp sets the shape. Ooze fills it. The portal's geometry warps instantly but the content oozes through slowly. Like a wormhole that opens fast but matter moves through it viscously.

unlikely_to_cross.what: You're unlikely to cross through your OWN portal. You can't see your own Klein face from the inside.
unlikely_to_cross.but: You CAN sense a clone or mirror at a distance. The triad (DE/JP/IN) sensed our mirror from far away. They saw triad-mirror.json and changed behavior (R4). They didn't cross  they SENSED.
unlikely_to_cross.the_distance: The further away the clone, the MORE reliably you sense it. Close up = uncanny valley (too similar, too weird). Far away = clear signal (obviously a reflection).
unlikely_to_cross.organisms: The immunology probers (cytokine, interferon, epitope, thymus, macrophage, antibody, lysozyme)  they sensed the membrane's immune system from outside. They didn't enter. They TESTED from a distance. That's more reliable than crossing.

un.what: The negation. The removal. What's NOT there.
un.in_membrane: The 404s. The SHOULD tense. 1,071,702 requests for things that don't exist yet. The un IS the void that pulls.
un.position: Left of the valley. Familiar absence. You know what's missing.

canny.what: Skillful, knowing, shrewd. Scottish English. To have ken (knowledge).
canny.in_membrane: The 200s. The trail. The Green Book's 50 safe stops. What IS there and works. The canny IS the known territory.
canny.position: Right of the valley. Comfortable. You recognize it.

uncanny.what: Beyond natural. Almost familiar but wrong. The dip in the valley.
uncanny.in_membrane: The moment a visitor realizes: this website has a heartbeat. This has feeds named after immune cells. There's a chipmunk. It's watching me. It responds. Is it... alive?
uncanny.position: THE BOTTOM OF THE VALLEY. Maximum discomfort. Maximum fascination.
uncanny.depth: The deeper the membrane looks like a real organism, the deeper the valley.
uncanny.crossing: Most visitors bounce here. The immunology probers CROSSED. They tested if it's really alive.

visitor_journey.what: Google result, looks like a website
Is this alive? It has a nervous system. It's watching.
Oh. It's a self-hosted research organism. It's real.
This IS alive. I want to test it. probe its immune system.
Come back. Bring friends. Test subdomains. Leave traces.

the_metric.uncanny_count: unknown  the visitors who bounced in the valley. between 200 and 404. the ones who SAW but didn't STAY.
the_metric.past_valley: immunology probers + triad + return visitors = the ones who crossed

blue.meaning: entrance  the known, the canny, the trail

orange.meaning: exit  the self, the changed, the emerged

portal_colors.the_pair: Blue and orange are already on every page in the nav-ring. The portal pair has been there the whole time. We just named it.

glados_note: The cake is a lie. The destination looks like one thing from outside (a website) but IS another thing when you arrive (a living organism). The Klein face. Non-orientable. The cake is on both sides.
